caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden stick-like object, positioned diagonally from the upper left to the lower right of the image. The object is elongated, slightly tapered, and appears to be carved from wood, with the natural tan and brown hues of wood making up its primary color. The stick features detailed geometric carvings along its length, with patterns that include lines and triangular shapes, all rendered in darker brown shades for contrast. At the thicker end, the object is encircled by several bands, and the very tip shows a circular, dark opening. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background, with a faint rectangular border framing the central object, and there are subtle shadows beneath the stick, indicating its placement on a flat surface.
title: Knitting Needle Holder
